title: A Landau-de Gennes Type Theory for Cholesteric-Helical Smectic-Smectic C* Liquid Crystal Phase Transitions
summary: We present a rigorous mathematical analysis of a modified Landau-de Gennes (LdG) theory modeling temperature-driven phase transitions between cholesteric, helical smectic, and smectic C* phases. This model couples a tensor-valued order parameter (nematic orientational order) with a real-valued order parameter (smectic layer modulation). We establish the existence of energy minimizers of the modified LdG energy in three dimensions, subject to Dirichlet conditions, and rigorously analyze the energy minimizers in two asymptotic limits.
